cases.sentence: У Ревекки был ___ по имени Лаван.
cases.translation: Rebekah had a brother named Laban.
cases.explain: Брат is the subject of the existential был, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Господь, Бог неба, который вывел меня из ___ отца моего...
cases.translation: The Lord, the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father's house...
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Авраам сказал старшему ___ в своем доме, который распоряжался всем, что у него было.
cases.translation: Abraham said to the eldest servant in his house, who managed all that he had.
cases.explain: The verb сказать takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он опустил ___ на колени у источника за пределами города.
cases.translation: He made the camel kneel down by the well outside the city.
cases.explain: The verb опустить takes its direct object in the accusative case; being animate, it matches the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Ревекка вышла к источнику с ___ на плече.
cases.translation: Rebekah came out to the spring with a jar on her shoulder.
cases.explain: The preposition с ('with') governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Ревекка вышла к источнику с кувшином на ___.
cases.translation: Rebekah came out to the spring with a jar on her shoulder.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Слуга взял десять верблюдов своего ___ и, нагрузив их лучшими подарками, отправился в путь.
cases.translation: The servant took ten of his master's camels, and loading them with the best gifts, set out on the way.
cases.explain: The genitive господина shows possession — 'his master's camels'.

cases.sentence: Он склонился и восславил ___, сказав, «Хвала Господу, Богу моего господина Авраама».
cases.translation: He bowed down and praised the Lord, saying, 'Praise be to the Lord, the God of my master Abraham.'
cases.explain: The verb восславить takes its direct object in the accusative case.

reading.ru: Авраам был уже стар в преклонных годах, и Господь благословил его во всем.
reading.question: What is said about Abraham at the start of the chapter?
options: He was old and the Lord had blessed him in everything
He had just arrived in Canaan
He was ill and near death
reading.correct: He was old and the Lord had blessed him in everything
reading.explain: The text opens saying Abraham was old and the Lord had blessed him in all things.

reading.ru: Авраам сказал старшему слуге в своем доме, который распоряжался всем, что у него было.
reading.question: To whom did Abraham give his instructions?
options: To the eldest servant who managed all he had
reading.correct: To the eldest servant who managed all he had
reading.explain: Abraham spoke to his eldest servant, who ruled over everything he owned.

reading.ru: Положи руку мне под бедро и поклянись мне, Господом, Богом неба и Богом земли, что ты не возьмешь моему сыну жены из дочерей хананеев, среди которых я живу
reading.question: What did Abraham make the servant swear?
options: Not to take a wife for Isaac from the Canaanites
To bring Isaac back to Mesopotamia
To give all his wealth to Isaac immediately
To never return to Canaan himself
reading.correct: Not to take a wife for Isaac from the Canaanites
reading.explain: Abraham made the servant swear not to take a wife for his son from the daughters of the Canaanites.

reading.ru: Слуга положил руку под бедро своего господина Авраама и поклялся ему.
reading.question: How did the servant confirm his oath?
options: He put his hand under Abraham's thigh and swore
reading.correct: He put his hand under Abraham's thigh and swore
reading.explain: The text says the servant put his hand under his master's thigh and swore to him.

reading.ru: Потом слуга взял десять верблюдов своего господина и, нагрузив их лучшими подарками, от него отправился в путь.
reading.question: What did the servant take with him on the journey?
options: Ten camels loaded with the best gifts
reading.correct: Ten camels loaded with the best gifts
reading.explain: The text says the servant took ten of his master's camels, loaded with the best gifts.

reading.ru: Он опустил верблюдов на колени у источника за пределами города. Это было под вечер, когда женщины приходят за водой.
reading.question: When did the servant arrive at the well?
options: In the evening, when women come to draw water
At dawn, before anyone was awake
At noon, during the hottest hour
reading.correct: In the evening, when women come to draw water
reading.explain: The text says it was evening, the time when women come out to draw water.

reading.ru: Если я скажу девушке, «Пожалуйста, опусти кувшин с плеча, чтобы мне напиться», а она ответит, «Пей, а я напою и твоих верблюдов», то ее ты и назначил для слуги твоего Исаака
reading.question: What sign did the servant ask God for to identify the right wife for Isaac?
options: A girl who would offer water to him and his camels
A girl wearing a specific color
A girl who would sing a song
A girl who would be alone at the well
reading.correct: A girl who would offer water to him and his camels
reading.explain: The servant prayed that the girl who offered to water him and his camels would be the one appointed for Isaac.

reading.ru: Она была очень красивая девушка, девственница, которая еще не была с мужчиной.
reading.question: How is Rebekah described when she came to the well?
reading.explain: The text describes Rebekah as very beautiful, a virgin who had not known a man.

reading.ru: Она быстро вылила воду из кувшина в поилку, побежала обратно к источнику зачерпнуть еще воды и начерпала для всех его верблюдов.
reading.question: What did Rebekah do for the servant's camels?
options: She drew water for all of them
She led them to a stable
reading.correct: She drew water for all of them
reading.explain: The text says she poured water and ran back to draw more until all the camels had water.

reading.ru: Когда верблюды напились, тот человек вынул золотую серьгу для носа весом в беку и два золотых браслета весом в десять шекелей
reading.question: What gifts did the servant give Rebekah at the well?
options: A gold nose ring and two gold bracelets
reading.correct: A gold nose ring and two gold bracelets
reading.explain: The text says the servant took out a gold nose ring and two gold bracelets.

reading.ru: У Ревекки был брат по имени Лаван.
reading.question: Who was Rebekah's brother?
reading.explain: The text states Rebekah had a brother named Laban.

reading.ru: «Пойдем к нам, благословенный Господом», — сказал Лаван.
reading.question: How did Laban greet the servant?
options: He invited him in, calling him blessed of the Lord
reading.correct: He invited him in, calling him blessed of the Lord
reading.explain: Laban said, 'Come in, you blessed of the Lord.'

reading.ru: Я не стану есть, пока не расскажу о моем поручении
reading.question: What did the servant insist on doing before eating?
reading.explain: The servant said he would not eat until he had told them his errand.

reading.ru: Жена моего господина Сара родила ему сына в старости, и он завещал ему все, что у него есть
reading.question: What did the servant say Abraham had done regarding his inheritance?
options: He willed everything he had to Isaac
He divided his wealth between his sons
He gave everything to his servants
reading.correct: He willed everything he had to Isaac
reading.explain: The servant said Abraham had willed all he had to the son Sarah bore him in her old age.

reading.ru: Лаван и Битуил ответили, «Это дело от Господа, не нам говорить тебе, да или нет.
reading.question: How did Laban and Bethuel respond to the servant's request?
options: They said the matter was from the Lord
They asked for a delay of a year
reading.correct: They said the matter was from the Lord
reading.explain: Laban and Bethuel answered that the matter came from the Lord, so they could not say yes or no themselves.

reading.ru: Они позвали Ревекку и спросили, «Пойдешь с этим человеком?» «Пойду», — ответила она.
reading.question: What did Rebekah answer when asked if she would go with the servant?
reading.explain: When asked if she would go with the man, Rebekah answered, 'I will go.'

reading.ru: Исаак вернулся из Бер-Лахай-Рои, он жил в Нигеве. И вот вечером он вышел в поле и поднял взгляд и увидел, что идут верблюды.
reading.question: What was Isaac doing when he first saw the camels approaching?
options: He went out into the field in the evening
He was sleeping in his tent
reading.correct: He went out into the field in the evening
reading.explain: The text says Isaac went out into the field in the evening and saw the camels coming.

reading.ru: Исаак ввел Ревекку в шатер своей матери Сары и взял ее в жены. Она стала его женой, и он полюбил ее. И так Исаак утешился после смерти матери.
reading.question: How does the chapter conclude?
options: Isaac married Rebekah, loved her, and was comforted after his mother's death
Isaac rejected Rebekah at the last moment
Sarah returned to bless the marriage
Isaac moved to Egypt with Rebekah
reading.correct: Isaac married Rebekah, loved her, and was comforted after his mother's death
reading.explain: The text says Isaac took Rebekah as his wife, loved her, and was comforted after his mother's death.
